2020/07/05 v0.83 update

◎ New game management function: game copy/delete
◎ Added Steam workshop: game packaging/uploading/automatic download and installation
[code]1. The preview pictures of the workshop must be manually placed under workshop/<game>/, and will be uploaded together when uploading.
2. The name of the preview image file should be named preview.jpg. It is recommended to use a square image file so that there is no black border.
[/code]
◎ The process of packaging/uploading the game to the workshop:
[code]1. Title screen ==> Game list ==> Select the game to upload ==> Package ==> Upload
2. After the upload is successful, the system will automatically open the workshop website ==> manually modify the instructions
3. Under the work/<game>/ directory, manually add the preview.jpg file, upload it again, and the preview picture will be added.
[/code]
◎ Add edit command, which is convenient to modify the object file directly in the game. After opening the object editing function, there will be an additional edit button when viewing the object. After clicking, you can directly modify the object file.
[code]Command format: edit [ |id|here|config]
    edit
    edit config
    edit here
    edit skill <no>
    edit help <cmd>
Command explanation:
    Enable/disable object edit func, or edit files.
Command example:
    edit : enable/disable object edit func.
    edit mob : edit mob's file.
    edit config : edit game config.txt file.
    edit here : edit map file.
    edit skill 401 : edit skill/401.txt file.
    edit help go : edit help/go.txt file.
[/code]

2020/06/13 v0.82 update

◎Add the function of battle shortcut key
◎ Increase font size, font color adjustment function
◎ Increase the volume adjustment function
◎Play music function settings, changed to each Mud game can be individually set to facilitate games that do not need to use BGM.
On/off music, please modify the value of enable_music in assets/data/<game>/config.txt
[code]enable_music = 0, means to turn off the music
enable_music = 1, means to enable music
[/code]
◎Add the function of randomly placing Mob in the area, you can set the Mob in the area at one time, the generated Mob will be randomly placed in the room with "exit".
Please modify the map file... assets / data / <game> /map/xxx.txt, add a random_mobs attribute
[code] EX: ramdom_mobs = "1:10|2:10|3:10" [/code]
◎When fighting now, the general message will automatically guide the battle screen for easy viewing
◎The corpse object, add collection attribute and dedication/collection function, the attribute setting method is:
[code]datas = {
gathers="2002：1：100",  <== default collectable items, item id: quantity: probability (1/1000)
}
[/code]
◎ Add gather command
◎ The sacc command was changed to sac, but still only corpse objects can be dedicated.
◎The mob file adds collection attributes. For usage, please add collection attributes in the data
[code]datas = {
    gathers="2002：1：300", <==  item id: quantity: probability (1/1000)
    items = "2001：1：200", <==  item id: quantity: probability (1/1000)
}
[/code]
◎ Added raw meat items, item / 2002.txt, to be used for collecting the predetermined items.

notes.title: v0.81 update
notes.content:
2020/06/07 v0.81 update

◎ The trading window will now display the player's money
◎ Add music (BGM) function
    If you want close，please edit system/data/config.txt
    enable_music = 0，disable music
    enable_music = 1，enable music
◎ The combat speed can be set
    Please edit assets/data/<game>/config.txt
    fight_speed = 1000, means 1 round per 1 sec
    fight_speed = 500, means 1 round per 0.5 sec
◎ 2/4/6/8/7/9 of the numeric input keys on the right side of the keyboard can be used as mobile south/west/east/north/down/up, 5 is look
◎ Added text reminder after the battle
◎ Add set, tmp, oset, otmp, consider commands
◎ Modify the enable command, when no skills are entered, a list of skills that can be enabled will be displayed
◎ The "skill" command of battle only shows the skills that can be cast
◎ Solve the problem of high-resolution text blurry

notes.title: My Mud Game starts selling
notes.content:
The official version has been updated in several places according to the suggestions of netizens.
In addition, the background music function is still under development, and there are some bugs.
If you want to try something new, you can open it manually. The file is in system / data / config.txt.
After opening, set enable_music to 1, restart the game, and you will hear BGM after entering the village.
